Indian Standard 



DIMENSIONS AND TESTING REQUIREMENTS OF 
LANDING GEAR FOR MOUNTING ON SEMITRAILERS 



1. Scope — This standard lays down principal cliaracteristics and testing requirements of landing 
gear for its mounting on semitrailers. 

1.1 This standard is applicable to both manually and power operated landing gear. 

2. Ternninology — In addition to the terms given in 13:7774-1975 'Glossary of terms relating to 
transport tractors and trailers ', the following definitions shall apply, 

2.1 Landing Gear — A device for supporting the front portion of an unattached semitrailer, 

2.1 .1 IVIanual landing gear — A landing gear raised/lowered manually. 

2 A. 2 Power landing gear — A landing gear raised/lowered by mechanical hydraulic pneumatic 
means. 

2.2 Static Capacity — Maximum static load that can be supported by a pair of landing gears mounted 
on a semitrailer. 

2.3 Lifting Capacity — Maximum load on a pair of landing gear that can be raised in height by the 
operation of the landing gears. The manual efforts to raise the load should not exceed 45 kg. 

2A Closed Length — W\x\\vaurc\ overall length of the landing gear in fully retracted condition 
{see Fig. 1). 

2,5 Travel — Maximum length of landing gear, fully extended, as measured beyond closed length 
{see Fig. 1). 

3. Mounting Dimensions and Requirements — Dimensional details for mounting the landing gear 
shall be in accordance with Fig. 1. 

3.1 A landing gear shall be mounted on a semitrailer chassis in a way that hand brakes, levers, shafts 
and other moving parts do not interfere with landing gear physically as well as operatir^nally.

4. Testing 

4.1 Sfaf/c 7'e5?/V?5r — A pair of landing gear, arranged such that each member of the pair is subjected 
to equal load, shall be able to withstand 1'5 times its static capacity without showing any permanent 
set and/or cracks to any part. The loading should be such that it does not produce any impact loading 
on the landing gears. 

4.2 D/na/w/c 7es?/A?fl' — The conditions and load for dynamic testing should be as agreed to between 
the manufacturer and the buyer. 

5. Marking 

5.1 A landing gear shall be fitted with a plate providing the following information: 

a) Manufacturer's or supplier's name, 

b) Manufacturer's number and serial number, 

c) Year of manufacture, 

d) Static capacity per pair in kg, and 

e) Lifting capacity in kg. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is based on DIN 70100/1-1977 'Struts for semitrailers requirements' issued by 
the Deutsches Institutfiir Normung (DIN).
